# DepthGUI

> DepthGUI is a Minecraft resource pack that improves the game's interface by adding a clean and modern GUI style.
> 
> The goal of this pack is to make the HUD look more polished, minimalistic, and visually pleasing while keeping the original Minecraft feeling.

### ✨ Features

- Redesigned HUD

- Clean and minimalistic design

- Vanilla-friendly look

### 📦 Current Version

- Version 0.2
 
- Includes HUD and Widgets redesign

### 🚧 Future Plans

- Inventory redesign

- Menu GUI improvements

- Container textures (chests, crafting table, etc.)

- Additional UI polish
